Version history

A brief record of what changed in each release.

Version 1.9

August 17, 2026

Added a searchable, mobile-optimized Work Instructions library with four responsive guides, keyword results, highlighted matches, safety callouts, specifications, and optional access to seven public-safe original reference pages.

Version 1.8

August 17, 2026

Added No Response NGS with private on-device scanning, editable results, earlier-versus-current photo comparison, automatic increases, highest-to-lowest report sorting, photo-calibrated highlight detection, and strict safeguards against uncertain OCR values.

Version 1.7

August 17, 2026

Replaced the photo Home Screen icon with a professional matcha-themed clipboard and checkmark design.

Version 1.6

August 17, 2026

Added a custom photo home-screen icon and install settings for iPhone, Samsung, and other Android devices.

Version 1.5

August 17, 2026

Added permanent memory for the last selected PKG building—MI1 or MI2—without adding a permanent machine preference.

Version 1.4

August 17, 2026

Added this Version history screen to the main menu so each release has a clear, accessible summary.

Version 1.3

August 17, 2026

Added a blank PET Time entry beneath every failed machine in the ❌-only IQ report and refined its spacing for quick tech updates.

Version 1.2

August 17, 2026

Changed the exception workflow into a visible ❌-only preview. Copy IQ check now copies whichever preview—full or ❌ only—is displayed.

Version 1.1

August 17, 2026

Added permanent theme saving, a visible version label, and the first option for producing an IQ report containing only ❌ results.

Version 1.0

August 17, 2026

Established the mobile PKG Update and LNS IQ Check tools with ten themes, draft recovery, section controls, aligned previews, and copy-ready reports.
